semiconductor_relevance: High — Malvern Panalytical provides advanced analytical instruments critical for semiconductor process development and characterization.
summary: Malvern Panalytical specializes in analytical technologies that measure the chemical, physical, and structural properties of materials, including semiconductors. Their instruments are essential for thin film technology metrology and process development, offering capabilities such as full wafer mapping and high-resolution analysis.
capabilities: X-ray diffraction (XRD) systems for thin film characterization
Full wafer mapping systems up to 200 mm
